content.short: Huobi is a Seychelles-based cryptocurrency exchange.
content.description: Established in 2013, Huobi operates as a Seychelles-based cryptocurrency exchange that provides access to its Internet of Value (IoV) services, a full-featured trading platform, and a security and risk-management framework. Developers can leverage Huobi APIs to access a broad set of data endpoints, facilitating programmatic integration, data collection, and research workflows across digital asset markets and related applications.
